The structure of Co2As4P2Se4 (reduced formula CoAs2PSe2) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows As centers in tetrahedral environments coordinated by two Co and two P neighbors, while Co and P each have four Se neighbors. Corner-sharing between As tetrahedra is observed, along with corner-sharing between As tetrahedra and Co 4-vertex coordination polyhedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 12 sites.
